# Security Policy

> **Canonical source:** The authoritative version of this file is maintained in **NorCom.Engineering**. The copy in this repository is the active default surfaced to all NorCom-EHF repositories on GitHub.

---

## Supported Versions

We actively maintain and patch the most recent major release of each product. Older versions may receive critical security fixes on a best-effort basis.

| Version | Supported |
|---|---|
| Latest release | ✅ |
| Previous major | ⚠️ Critical fixes only |
| Older versions | ❌ |

---

## Reporting a Vulnerability

**Please do not open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.**

To report a vulnerability responsibly:

1. **GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting (preferred):**  
   Use the [Report a vulnerability](../../security/advisories/new) link on the repository's **Security** tab to submit a private advisory.

2. **Email:**  
   Send a detailed report to **security@norcom.no** with the subject line `[SECURITY] <repository name> – <brief description>`.

Please include as much of the following as possible:

- A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact
- Steps to reproduce or a proof-of-concept (PoC)
- Affected version(s) and environment details
- Any suggested mitigations

---

## Our Commitment

- We will acknowledge your report within **3 business days**.
- We will keep you informed of our progress as we investigate and fix the issue.
- We will credit reporters in the security advisory (unless you prefer to remain anonymous).
- We aim to release a patch within **30 days** of confirmation, depending on severity and complexity.

---

## Scope

This policy applies to all source code and infrastructure maintained under the **NorCom-EHF** GitHub organisation. Third-party dependencies are out of scope; please report vulnerabilities in those directly to the respective maintainers.

---

## Preferred Languages

We accept vulnerability reports in **Norwegian** or **English**.
